Run PubMed searches and export records

pubmed-search.Rd

Run PubMed searches through easyPubMed, combine parsed records across query chunks, deduplicate by PMID, and write CSV outputs. Progress and errors are reported with formatted cli messages that include the active chunk, query preview, and underlying PubMed or easyPubMed error.

query_pubmed(query, fetch = TRUE, parse = TRUE, format = "xml", verbose = TRUE)

run_pubmed_search(include_query, exclude_query = NULL, chunk = TRUE,
  limit = Inf, sleep = 0, verbose = TRUE)

combine_pubmed_data(results, dedupe_by = "pmid")

write_pubmed_csv(results, path, dedupe_by = "pmid", verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

query

A PubMed query string.

fetch

Whether to fetch matching PubMed records after querying.

parse

Whether to parse fetched PubMed records.

format

Fetch format passed to easyPubMed::epm_fetch().

verbose

Whether to print progress messages.

include_query

Terms to include in the PubMed search.

exclude_query

Optional terms to exclude from each include query chunk.

chunk

Whether to split top-level include terms joined by OR.

limit

Maximum number of chunks to run. Use Inf for all chunks.

sleep

Seconds to wait between chunk queries.

results

A list of easyPubMed results or data frames.

dedupe_by

Column used to deduplicate combined records.

path

Output CSV path. Parent directories are created when needed.

Value

query_pubmed() returns an easyPubMed result object. run_pubmed_search() returns a named list of result objects. combine_pubmed_data() and write_pubmed_csv() return a data frame.
